title: Condense library summary tiles
summary: Condensed the Libraries page saved-library summary from a wide path-heavy table into compact Movies/TV-style tiles with per-tile media counts and status inspection.
reason: The previous Saved Libraries banner/table duplicated summary counts, consumed vertical space, and exposed source paths that are not useful in the daily Libraries workflow.
behavior_before: The Libraries page showed a visible Saved Libraries heading, aggregate status chips, explanatory scan text, and a wide table with Library, Path, Type, Status, Media Files, Sidecars, Last Scan, and Actions columns.
behavior_after: The Libraries page shows compact saved-library tiles. Each tile keeps the library name/type, enabled state, media-file count, sidecar count, and a focusable status symbol that opens scan/status details; source paths are no longer rendered in the summary.
